title: Cook's Additions
description: This is a texture pack for the Blockgame server. It adds textures to over 350 different spells, consumables, and materials.
body:
### Description
This is a resource pack that gives textures to 415 different custom items from the Blockgame minecraft server by Pirate Software.

In the base server all items use vanilla textures but there are not enough textures for all the custom items. This causes duplicate textures between different items that can be confusing unless you hover over every item. This pack fixes that problem by giving many items new texture seperate from the vanilla ones. This pack also includes Cartee's Feesh textures. 

### Prerequisites
This pack requires the Blockgame Resourcepacks Helper mod made by Bluepanda22. https://modrinth.com/project/94GecYBw

### Credits
This project was started by Pleverr but updated and expanded by CarteeCat.
